subject: general
question: Study of tissue is called ________.
solution:
The study of tissue is called __**Histology**__. A tissue is a group of cells which has similar structure and functions.

 
• **Virology:** It is the branch of science that deals with the study of viruses.
 
• **Oology:** It is the study of bird eggs and nests.
 
• **Cytology:** It is the branches of biology and medicine concerned with the structure and function of plant and animal cells.
